items.source_en:
It's been a crazy 24 hours and I'm exhausted. Trident short-staffed the flight so that left three of us who had to stay up all night to set up the Starview Ballroom. Place looks amazing, but I doubt the snobby "TPS" passengers will even notice. Anyone that has enough money to ride on the Siren certainly isn't going to care about the effort we put in to keep them comfortable. Really ticks me off how those rich folk just expect all of it to happen.

Maybe it's time I took Havertino up on his offer to transfer to Trident's Cargo Division. Honest work and no one thumbing their nose up at me? Sounds tempting.
items.legacy_ko:
정신없는 24시간이었다. 완전히 탈진 상태다. 트라이던트가 항해편에 인원을 적게 배치하는 바람에 남은 우리 셋이서 밤새 스타뷰 무도회장을 준비해야 했다. 멋지게 꾸미긴 했지만 저 거만한 'TPS' 승객들은 눈치도 못 챌 거다. 세이렌을 탈 정도로 돈이 많은 사람들은 당신들을 편안하게 하려고 우리가 노력하는 것 따위는 신경도 쓰지 않을 테니까. 부자 놈들은 어떻게 이런 게 당연히 일어날 것이라고 생각하는지 참 거슬린다.

items.source_en:
Fluctuations in water and temperature yielded no observable impact on behavior. We have discovered that the compound increases the organism's ability to utilize greater exposure to natural light. Observing the process by taking a tissue sample to examine under a microscope, we appear to have pinpointed the mechanism responsible for excessive growth.  

Heightened levels of carotenoids were detected, and additional vacuoles had developed in the leaf tissue composed almost entirely of accessory light harvesting pigments. We conclude that bioavailbity of the compound circulating within the organisms vascular system directly correlates with growth when paired with an elevated exposure to natural light.
